proposed_widenings.name: permanent_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', whose header mandates activationCost, resource (use_count), and resetCadence. Epic Boon is a one-time permanent acquisition at level-up — not an activatable feature with a use pool. There is no honest way to represent 'you gain a feat permanently when you reach level 19' inside the activation family without fabricating fake use_count and resetCadence values.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 effect atom inventory has grant_proficiency and grant_spell_access but no 'grant_feat'. A permanent-grant family would need a corresponding effect atom to record what is granted at level-up.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.

notes: Epic Boon is structurally identical to every Ability Score Improvement feature (barbarian L4, bard L4, etc.) — all are 'choose a feat or ASI at level-up'. The surface currently has no family for this very common class-progression pattern. A new family such as 'permanent_grant' with a choice-at-level-up mechanic would also cover all ASI/feat entries across all 12 classes. The recommended feat (Boon of Irresistible Offense) has its own mechanics that would be encoded separately as a feat record — out of scope here.
